title: CSCI 243 — The Mechanics of Programming
subject: Programming and Languages
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Identify the core components of program structure (variables, expressions, control structures, functions) and explain their roles in algorithm design.
Trace the program translation process from source code through lexical analysis, parsing, and execution, citing Python-specific mechanisms.
Apply debugging and correctness techniques (tests, tracing, boundary analysis) to evaluate program behavior against intended specifications.
